mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness, prompting policy stimulus expectations and boosting equity markets with positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad-based demand contraction, triggering a sell-off and negative 5-day returns.
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals economic slowdown, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In supply constraint regimes, INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually but 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, leading to expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS MoM change > 0.5%) does not yield positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a deepening economic slowdown, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, when RSAFS MoM change < 0.0%, 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
